chapter: Chords, recordings and his own groups
title: Origins of the top-note method; ballads and Johnny Smith
summary: He took years to work out notation, uses chords for the first chorus mostly on ballads, and says earlier guitarists played single strings.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What to think while improvising: wrong notes and being in the moment

blocks.x: When did you start writing things out like this.

I had a terrible time getting started to try to figure it out and I wasted quite a bit of time on this thing doing it another funny way I had... I... It didn't go over because I was naming chords, and the chords that I was naming were right but when you put the bass to it then it made it a different thing, you see... A lot of people start from the tonic but I come from the top.
Do you name the chords? I notice here TN A 2.
No that means top note. See that's where this thing comes, under thing you see TN 2, means top note, 2nd string... I also... Feel free to name your own chords...
Is this something you have developed recently.

Take a song like Caravan, it doesn't have but one chord for quite a few bars, C. And the rest is a whole bunch of notes. But see I manage to put chords to those notes. I made every note a chord out of it. And therefore it comes out very much different.
... And every one note there's a chord...
Did you use these same kind of principals when you were playing earlier on?

No, I didn't know 'em --- Strictly single string. Everybody was single string. The only someone who turned things around was Johnny Smith. He was very good on ballads. But I notice there were quite a few notes left but that he would make into a passage... So I just tried to make my whole first chorus of the song in chords -- all chords -- no single notes period. ...
Single notes comes in blues and other songs -- tempo songs.
So you use this mostly on ballads?

Yeah, this type of thing is for ballads. Couple of times got speed, we have Cherokee and Caravan is pretty well up, its got a good bouncy tempo, and several more. Its not all ballads, but 75% ballads. ...
